decisions.decision: GetAllMonitors() dedups by stable DevicePath; sources Active/Primary state only from GetActiveMonitors(), never from potentially-stale inactive PathInfo fields
decisions.rationale: Rig-confirmed bug: GetAllPaths() returns one entry per historical CCD path, causing duplicate rows and dual-primary in the Settings grid

decisions.decision: Restore() only takes the raw in-process cache-replay fast path on an exact SetEquals match between the cache and previousState.Paths; any DISPLAY-05 enable-set monitor (or genuinely stale cache) routes through RestoreViaReconstruction()
decisions.rationale: Rig-confirmed: the cache can legitimately contain an enable-set monitor whose Source-ID may have been renumbered by an intervening CCD mutation between cache-capture and replay; blindly replaying it doesn't throw but can silently leave the monitor inactive

decisions.decision: Settings grid columns relabeled 'Off (Rig)'/'On (Rig)' (was 'Disable'/'Enable') with tooltips and a permanent explanatory caption
decisions.rationale: User feedback: original labels didn't convey that the grid only configures the transition into Rig Mode; Normal Mode is always restored exactly as it was, never separately configured
